sdc.daemon.EventKind.title: EventKind
sdc.daemon.EventKind.description: Open text: the kind of the runtime's run-log line, copied. Events the daemon writes itself have a kind that starts with `runbook.`, and the command that writes each one declares it: runbook.submitted (SubmitRun), runbook.cancel-requested (CancelRun), runbook.start-failed (FailRunStart), runbook.run-orphaned (EndOrphanedRun), runbook.answer-undeliverable (AnswerDecision) and runbook.runtime-failed (written by the daemon just before it issues EndRun with the outcome runtime-failure), runbook.step-failed (written by the daemon just before it issues EndRun with the outcome `failed: step <action> exit <n>`, when the last program of the run's tree ended with an exit other than 0 and the tree has no other action to take; record: case, action, exit, reason) and runbook.action-started (written by the daemon when the runtime tells that a program of an action, or its `handoff_when` check, is about to start, before the program starts; record: case, action, role (`program` or `check`) and try, each absent when unknown; the language cannot write a RunEvent from a command, so it is stated here, and the view RunDetail shows the step while the program runs). Not a closed set for the runtime's own kinds.
